title: 吴越被AI换脸，怎么识破？
title_en: Wu Yue was deepfaked. How do you catch it?

segments.zh: 凌晨三点，演员吴越发了一条很生气的微博：
segments.en: 3 a.m.: actress Wu Yue posts an angry message.

segments.zh: 视频里那个卖护肤品的“我”，不是我！
segments.en: The 'me' selling skincare in that video is not me!

segments.zh: 脸是她的，声音也像她的，可全是AI做的。
segments.en: Her face, her voice, almost. All made by AI.

segments.zh: 视频里的“她”还说：这个产品不是他们找我，是我找他们。
segments.en: The fake her even says: they didn't come to me, I went to them.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：AI是怎么偷走一张脸的？
segments.en: Today's question: how does AI steal a face?

segments.zh: 你又该怎么识破？
segments.en: And how do you catch it?

segments.zh: 再烧一点：连明星本人都很难证明“我是我”，我们普通人看什么？
segments.en: Harder one: if even a star can't prove she's herself, what do the rest of us look at?

segments.zh: 先认识今天的主角：小画，一个AI画像师。
segments.en: Meet our star: Doodle, an AI portrait painter.

segments.zh: 小画干活分两步。第一步：看你的脸，只记笔记。
segments.en: Doodle works in two steps. Step one: look at a face, and only take notes.

segments.zh: 笔记上没有长相，只有几个数：
segments.en: The notes have no looks, just numbers:

segments.zh: 嘴角翘多少，头往哪边转，眼睛眨没眨。
segments.en: how much you smile, which way you turn, whether you blink.

segments.zh: 第二步：拿着这份笔记，照另一个人的样子，重新画一张脸。
segments.en: Step two: take those notes and redraw them as somebody else's face.

segments.zh: 这就是换脸：主播在镜头前笑，
segments.en: That's a face swap. The streamer smiles on camera,

segments.zh: 小画就画出一个“吴越”在笑。
segments.en: and Doodle paints a 'Wu Yue' smiling.

segments.zh: 打个比方：同一份舞谱，交给两个舞者，跳出来是两个人。
segments.en: Think of a dance score: same steps, two dancers, two different people.

segments.zh: 声音也一样。常见的说法是：
segments.en: Voices work the same way. A common claim:

segments.zh: 几十秒录音，就能学会一个人的音色。
segments.en: a few dozen seconds of audio is enough to copy one.

segments.zh: 而且据报道，大约一千二百八十元，
segments.en: And reportedly, about 1,280 yuan

segments.zh: 就能在直播里实时换脸。
segments.en: buys you a live face swap during a stream.

segments.zh: 反转一：这么便宜，被冒充的就不止吴越。
segments.en: Twist one: that cheap, and it's not just Wu Yue.

segments.zh: 同一个视频的结尾，还冒出了邓亚萍在“带货”。
segments.en: The same video ends with table tennis legend Deng Yaping 'selling' stuff too.

segments.zh: 演员温峥嵘也遇到过AI盗播，她说：我很难证明我是我。
segments.en: Actress Wen Zhengrong hit AI copycats too. She said: it's hard to prove I am me.

segments.zh: 那小画有没有画不好的地方？有，下面是常见破绽。
segments.en: So does Doodle ever mess up? Yes. Here are common tells.

segments.zh: 破绽一：让人侧过脸。小画多半是看正脸学的，
segments.en: Tell one: turn sideways. Doodle mostly learned from front faces.

segments.zh: 转到九十度，脸容易糊。
segments.en: At ninety degrees, the face can smear.

segments.zh: 破绽二：用手在脸前挡一下。手和脸叠在一起，小画常常画穿帮。
segments.en: Tell two: wave a hand in front of the face. Hand plus face often breaks the painting.

segments.zh: 破绽三：看牙齿、眼镜边、耳环。细节越多，越容易出错。
segments.en: Tell three: teeth, glasses rims, earrings. More detail, more mistakes.

segments.zh: 破绽四：光从左边来，影子也在左边。
segments.en: Tell four: light from the left, shadow also on the left.

segments.zh: 光影对不上，就要多个心眼。
segments.en: If light and shadow disagree, be suspicious.

segments.zh: 破绽五：嘴型和声音，对不齐。
segments.en: Tell five: lips and voice out of sync.

segments.zh: 反转二，最反直觉：这些破绽，正在一个一个被补上。
segments.en: Twist two, the weird one: these tells are being fixed, one by one.

segments.zh: AI一年比一年画得好。
segments.en: AI paints better every year.

segments.zh: 靠眼睛找破绽，就像跟魔术师比手快。
segments.en: Spotting tells by eye is like out-speeding a magician.

segments.zh: 所以，最靠得住的不是看脸，是看渠道。
segments.en: So the safest check isn't the face. It's the channel.

segments.zh: 看账号：有没有官方认证，是不是本人的号。
segments.en: Check the account: is it verified, is it really hers?

segments.zh: 看话术：“今天最后一天”，“只剩最后几单”。
segments.en: Check the pitch: 'last day!', 'only a few left!'

segments.zh: 它在催你，你就慢一点。
segments.en: When it rushes you, slow down.

segments.zh: 看付款：叫你私下转账的，一律不信。
segments.en: Check the payment: anyone asking for a private transfer, no.

segments.zh: 还有一条规矩：从二零二五年九月一日起，AI生成的内容必须加标识。
segments.en: One more rule: since September 1, 2025, China requires AI-made content to be labeled.

segments.zh: 这次的视频下面也写了“含AI生成内容”，
segments.en: This video did say 'contains AI content',

segments.zh: 只是字很小，很不显眼。
segments.en: in tiny, easy-to-miss print.

segments.zh: 所以刷视频时，多看一眼角落。
segments.en: So when you scroll, glance at the corners.

segments.zh: 后来，涉事账号已被永久封禁，内容清空。
segments.en: The account has since been banned for good, its videos wiped.

segments.zh: 友情提示：哪个破绽管用，因视频而异。
segments.en: Friendly fine print: which tells work varies by video.

segments.zh: 今天说的是常见情况，不是万能检测法。
segments.en: These are common cases, not a magic detector.

segments.zh: 回到开头：明星怎么证明我是我？
segments.en: Back to the start: how does a star prove she's herself?

segments.zh: 答案是：不用证明脸，要证明渠道。
segments.en: Answer: don't prove the face, prove the channel.

segments.zh: 真吴越，在她自己认证的账号里。
segments.en: The real Wu Yue lives on her own verified account.

segments.zh: 小画说：我能画出任何一张脸，
segments.en: Doodle says: I can paint any face.

segments.zh: 可我登不上你的账号。
segments.en: I just can't log into your account.
